g.text: Illustrative example, not a result: Population A and B are constructed with the same mean receptor count (A: 20.0, B: 20.0) but different shape (B is zero-inflated). Passed through the

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: same nonlinear capture curve (left panel), they yield different total capture: 61.4% (A) vs. 44.0% (B), a difference a mean-only comparison cannot detect. This illustrates the general

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: mechanism behind the reordering findings in this project.
